approved_payload.content: Three suspects wanted for serious and violent crimes in Phoenix and Inanda were shot dead in a shootout with police at a residence in the Ezimangweni area of Amaoti, Inanda, on Wednesday 25 November, KZN police spokesperson Col Robert Netshiunda said, via IOL and The Witness. Police say the suspects had earlier opened fire on a police patrol vehicle in Inanda; the officers were unhurt. Two firearms were recovered for ballistic testing. The two reports differ on the time: IOL says morning, The Witness says afternoon. The map point is approximate: the Inanda area point, not the house.
